snippet.title: 『Time Snatcher Handy』Official Trailer
snippet.description:
The universe's greatest cat burglar? The ultimate phantom thief across dimensions?
Nah... Time Snatcher Handy, that's me!
A time-stop bullet-hell action roguelike starring "Handy" the stylish cat burglar!

Time Snatcher Handy

"Handy," the feline phantom thief, has stolen a clock hand from the Time Museum.
Wield its mysterious power to freeze time, slip through merciless curtains of bullets, outsmart patrolling guards, and claw your way out of the Time Museum!

📌Time-Stop Bullet-Hell Action Roguelike!
At do-or-die moments, stop time to dodge patterns, line up the perfect strike, and take control of the battlefield.
Master the rhythm between frozen instants and live danger to turn the tide!

📌The Only Resource is "Time!"
Every action spends "time." When the clock hits zero, the clock hand's power rewinds the run to the moment Handy first touched it.
Manage your time across Time Stop, HP, and shopping.
Defeat enemies and gather "Timeshards" to extend your escape!

📌Diverse Items and Strategic Builds
The museum is packed with exhibits beyond the clock hand!
Borrow and combine items to create powerful synergies and grow stronger!

📌Varied Level Mechanics and Bosses That Bar Your Escape 
The closer Handy gets to freedom, the tougher the enemies and bosses.
Each area introduces unique level mechanics and attack patterns.
Use Time Stop and your borrowed loadout to overcome every roadblock!

📌Costume Change, Handy! 
Costumes don't just make Handy look cool. They also remix gameplay with distinct twists! 
Find the style that fits you and crack the museum's defenses in your own way!

【Product Info】
・Title: Time Snatcher Handy
・Platform : Windows PC (Steam, STOVE)
・Minimum: OS: Windows 10/Processor: Intel Core Ultra 5/Memory: 4 GB RAM
Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 900 Series/Storage: 500 MB available space
・Genre: Time-Stop Bullet-Hell Action Roguelike
・Languages: English, Japanese, Korean, Chinese (Traditional), Chinese (Simplified)
・Players: 1
・Rated: GRAC All
・Developer: ClockworkCats.
・Publisher: Cometsoft Inc.
・Release date : in 2025
・Price : TBD
・Steam Store Page : https://store.steampowered.com/app/3191110/_/
・STOVE Store Page : https://store.onstove.com/ja/games/5103
